samples.question: The gray object at the top is a pair of two gray disks separated by a specific center-to-center distance. Below it are three colored objects A, B, C: one is red, one green, one blue, and each is a pair of two same-colored disks separated by a different center-to-center distance. Which colored object has the two disks of its pair separated by exactly the same center-to-center distance as the gray pair? Answer red, green, or blue.
